map.依据 Cooper 12 分钟跑测试，由跑动距离推算最大摄氧量 VO₂max，评: Based on the Cooper 12-minute run test, estimate maximal oxygen uptake VO₂max from the running distance to assess cardiorespiratory endurance.

map.输入 1.5 英里（约 2.4km）跑的时间，用 Cooper 配速公式估算 V: Enter the time to run 1.5 miles (about 2.4 km) and estimate VO₂max with the Cooper pace formula
map.VO₂max = (跑动距离(m) − 504.9) / 44.73（Coope: VO₂max = (running distance (m) − 504.9) / 44.73 (Cooper 12-minute run); average pace = 12 minutes / distance
map.Cooper 12 分钟跑测试常用于场地与跑步机：记录 12 分钟内完成的最大距: The Cooper 12-minute run test is commonly used on a track or treadmill: record the maximum distance covered in 12 minutes and plug it into the formula to get maximal oxygen uptake (ml/kg/min); the other mode works backwards from the finish time (VO₂max = 483 / time + 3.5). Results give an endurance grade by sex and age band.
map.Cooper 测试：在平坦场地全力跑 12 分钟，记录总距离。公式：VO₂max: Cooper test: run all-out for 12 minutes on flat ground and record the total distance. Formula: VO₂max = (distance in metres − 504.9) / 44.73. 1.5-mile run formula: VO₂max = (483 / time in minutes) + 3.5.
map.此测试为最大强度运动，有心血管疾病或长期未运动者应在医生指导下进行，切勿勉强。: This test is maximal-intensity exercise; those with cardiovascular disease or who have not exercised for a long time should do it under medical supervision and must not push themselves.
map.在平坦场地全力跑/快走 12 分钟，记录总距离，用 Cooper 公式估算最大摄: Run / brisk-walk all-out for 12 minutes on flat ground, record the total distance, and estimate maximal oxygen uptake with the Cooper formula.
map.也可用 1.5 英里跑用时反推 VO₂max，两种口径交叉验证。: You can also derive VO₂max from the 1.5-mile run time, cross-validating with the two measures.
map.按年龄/性别查等级表，评估心肺耐力水平并制定有氧目标。: Look up the rating table by age/sex, assess cardiorespiratory endurance and set aerobic goals.
map.可复现算例：12 分钟跑 2800m（男 30 岁）: Reproducible example: 2800 m in 12 minutes (man aged 30)
map.输入：距离 2800 m、年龄 30、性别 男。\nCooper 距离公式：VO:
Input: distance 2800 m, age 30, sex male.
Cooper distance formula: VO₂max=(2800−504.9)/44.73=2295.1/44.73≈51.3 ml/kg/min.
Average pace=720/(2800/1000)=720/2.8≈257 seconds/km≈4:17/km.
Rating: male, 30 years, 51.3 ml/kg/min is in the excellent band (men 30–39 excellent line about 47.9+).
Supplemental 1.5-mile formula: if 1.5 miles takes 11 minutes, VO₂max=483/11+3.5=43.9+3.5=47.4 ml/kg/min, of the same order as the distance method.
Conclusion: 2800 m in 12 minutes corresponds to VO₂max≈51.3 ml/kg/min, an excellent level, at a pace of about 4:17/km.
map.Cooper 12 分钟跑公式是经典场地推算（误差约 ±5–10%），适合大众自: The Cooper 12-minute run formula is a classic field estimate (error about ±5–10%) and suits self-testing trends for the general public; a laboratory gas analysis measuring VO₂max directly is the most accurate. A thorough warm-up and flat ground before running reduce error.
map.距离法和 1.5 英里法结果不同怎么办？: What if the distance method and the 1.5-mile method differ?
map.两者都是经验回归、样本与公式不同会有偏差，取相近量级即可。本工具分别给出并各自查: Both are empirical regressions, and different samples and formulas cause deviations, so a similar order of magnitude is enough. This tool gives both and looks up each rating; if they differ a lot, prefer the one on the day you are stronger and steadier, and use the same method for long-term tracking.
